answer: Threshold e-cash is issued by a quorum of banks who blind-sign coins without learning their serial numbers, and the ember of the design is that a coin is valid only when a threshold signed it. The onyx of the protocol is that double spending is detected when the same serial appears twice, so a Sybil cannot spend one coin under many identities. The banks never learn who holds which coin, and the canyon of the threshold keeps issuance honest even if some banks are corrupt.
